# H2 (tweak-and-reuse) and H3 (invalidation) fuzzers, CACHE_CAMPAIGN.md Tier 2: probes/cache/src/optimus/graph/CacheHunter.scala
# JDK 21.0.12.1, 18-core Mac. Logs: $TMPDIR scratchpad cache-hunter/{sweep-h2,sweep-h3,checks}.
#
# Commands
#   probes/cache/run-cache-hunter.sh selftest 60                     memoised oracle vs ProbeDag.SequentialEvaluator (20,064 checks, 0 mismatches)
#   HUNTER_PAR=6  probes/cache/run-cache-hunter.sh sweep h2 1 40     40 seeds x {ideal 1,2,4} x {asserts} x {delay 50us}            = 480 runs, 9 min
#   HUNTER_PAR=10 probes/cache/run-cache-hunter.sh sweep h3 1 50     50 seeds x {ideal 1,2,4} x {asserts} x {delay} x {watermark 1} = 1200 runs, 23 min
#   probes/cache/run-cache-hunter.sh one h2|h3 <seed> <cfg> [reps] [off=..] [maxProps=N] [drop=i,j] [clients=N]
#   probes/cache/run-cache-hunter.sh spec h2|h3 <seed>               the generated DAG / scenario tree / tracker plan
#   $(probes/cache/run-cache-hunter.sh --print-cmd) optimus.graph.CacheHunter ttprobe|cancelprobe|tweakcancelprobe|tweakcancelprobe2   hand-written checks
#
# Oracles. H2: memoised SequentialEvaluator on every returned value (cancelled requests skipped; ISD expected where the oracle throws).
# H3: value oracle with version windows (each tracker's tweak level is versioned; a result must match the oracle for some combination
# of versions between "completed at request start" and "submitted at result"); at every phase checkpoint (queues idle, clients paused):
# queue liveness, stale check (every valid cached node the probe recorded via runHook must equal the oracle at the current state,
# then re-evaluated through the queue to see whether the stale value is served), invalidation oracle in both directions against the
# previous checkpoint's snapshot (over = invalidated without any touched read; under = valid although a read was touched), TTrack
# reachability (every valid cached node reachable from a root of every tweakable it read, excluding reads made by BYNAME RHS and when
# clauses, which the tracker does not root: ttprobe), H5-style scheduler accounting at the end, watchdog with classifying dumps.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SUMMARY OF FINDINGS
#
# NEW
#  N1 TAG_DOUBLE_WRAP (H, deterministic). Setting the same plugin tag twice on a DependencyTracker double-wraps the value:
#     MutableNodeInputMap.addInput (ScenarioStack.scala:1425) wraps the result of input.combine(...) in a new NodeInputMapValue, but
#     PluginTagKey.combine (PluginTagKey.scala:44) already returns a NodeInputMapValue. findPluginTag then returns
#     Some(NodeInputMapValue) typed as T: ClassCastException in any typed reader (or a silently wrong value for an untyped one).
#     ttprobe: "TAG-TWICE first=Success(3) findPluginTag after second set=Some(NodeInputMapValue(...)) tagReader in fresh child=Failure(ClassCastException ...)".
#     Fuzzer: EXC:TAG_DOUBLE_WRAP in 188 H3 runs / 13 seeds (every seed with tracker tags), 5/5 on rerun.
#  N2 CANCEL_LEAK (M-H, intermittent). An uncancelled request receives another request's OptimusCancellationException. LEAKDIAG on
#     h2 seed 34: the uncancelled key's child is a by-name TweakNode (p0 := BYNAME(p0*4+134), unordered + twice level) whose own stack
#     carries NullCancellationScope (cancelScopeAndEnvId equal to the requester's, so isUsableWRTCancelScopeAndEnv takes the fast path)
#     while its result is "OptimusCancellationException: hunter" from a cancelled child scope. Sticky: the cached TweakNode poisons every
#     later uncancelled request in that scenario. H2: 31 runs / 9 seeds, all ideal/asserts/delay settings, all policies (survives
#     off=xs,xsft). Repro: run-cache-hunter.sh one h2 34 i2-a0-d0 8 (3/8), one h2 7 i4-a0-d1 2 (2/2). Not a D1 (no XS needed).
#     Two hand-built shapes (tweakcancelprobe, tweakcancelprobe2: by-name RHS cancelled mid-flight, concurrent and later requester)
#     do NOT reproduce it, so the exact interleaving is still open; the LEAKDIAG lines below pin the poisoned node.
#  N3 STALE in a newChildScenario child of a concurrent child (M, candidate for R4 -> D6). h3 seed 29: tracker plan 0 <- 1 (concurrent)
#     <- 2 (consistent, created by newChildScenario mid-run). Nodes cached in t2 keep stale values after updates and are served again
#     (STALE_SERVED UNEXPLAINED, plus wrong values at evaluation). 8/8 runs, 4/4 with off=tags, 3/3 with off=tags,xs. Toggles that
#     remove it (3/3 each): newchild, byname, modes (all BYNAME), when, batch, addasync; toggles that keep it: lp, canceleval, xs, xsft,
#     addsync, evalasync, clientasync, tagupd. So: needs the late child, BIND/BIND_ONCE by-name tweaks and when clauses. Rarer instances
#     in other seeds, all on paths through a concurrent child: seed 14 (3/8), seed 32 (2/8). Repro: one h3 29 i2-a0-d0-w0 4 off=tags,xs
#  N4 R6 organic (H). No misuse needed: the updater holds queueLock in cancelAndRescheduleLowPriorityActions -> waitForCancelledNodesToStop
#     (spinning) while the cancelled low-priority node's own thread, inside a sync lookupAndGet -> runAndWait -> drainQueue, picks up the
#     queue's own completion callback (afterActionCompleted) and blocks on queueLock. Permanent hang. H3: 7 runs / 6 seeds at ideal 2 and 4,
#     plus 6 more during reruns. R6 was graded as needing an orphan to call a queue API; work stealing makes the queue call itself.
#  N5 R14 organic trigger (M). Rescheduling a cancelled low-priority action re-creates EvaluateNodeKeysLowPriorityAction whose lazy cause
#     is a child of the original EventCause, already completed: EventCauseInInvalidState thrown from cancelAndRescheduleLowPriorityActions
#     inside registerOrEnqueueAction, under schedulerAsserts. The *update* that triggered the reschedule throws to its caller and is not
#     applied (async variants throw synchronously from addTweaksAsync), and the low-priority action is lost. 22 runs / 16 seeds, a1 only.
#  N6 API hazard (L). invalidateCache clears STATE_DONE_FLAG (NodeTask.java:1143), so a node handed out by evaluateNodeKeysAsync and read
#     after a later update throws "Cannot request result of a node before its completion". Results must be read inside the callback.
#     (Fuzzer artefact at first; the harness now reads in the callback and counts the rest as eval.invalidatedBeforeRead.)
#
# KNOWN, given organic seeds
#  D1  XS + cancellation: wrong values (H2 ORACLE:XS, 55 runs / 19 seeds; off=cancel or off=xs removes it 4/4 -> 0/4) and, under trackers,
#      XS nodes served stale after an update (H3 STALE_SERVED:XS 88 runs / 31 seeds; off=canceleval,lp or off=xs removes it).
#  D4  ISD cached at the root id (ISD-where-value) and its dual, a root value served into an SI stack (value-where-ISD, removed by
#      off=xsft): H2 97 runs / 9 seeds, H3 10 runs.
#  F1  bind/bindOnce/by-name mode twins share a cache id: H2 8 runs / 2 seeds (MIN seed 11: removedBy modes,byname).
#  F8  cached tag readers ignore tags: H2 60 runs / 5 seeds; H3 208 runs / 13 seeds incl. STALE_SERVED after setPluginTag.
#  R2? one QUEUE_WEDGE at ideal 4 (in-flight many-node evaluation never completes); not separated from R10b at ideal 1.
#  XS + Tweak.bind: "Tweak.bind in cross-scenario node ... is not supported" (by design, counted as eval.xsBindUnsupported=80114) and, under
#      schedulerAsserts only, "Inconsistent TweakTreeNodes" GraphException (H2 EXC:GraphException, MIN seed 33: removedBy modes,byname,xs).
#  Scheduler R10b (SCHEDULER_REVIEW.md): every ideal=1 H3 configuration hangs (338 STALL + 48 WEDGE in the sweep, 386/400 runs).
#      Reclassified with the final build on 48 runs (seeds 1-6 x 8 ideal=1 cfgs): 45 SCHED_R10b (runnable work on _qqueue, workers=0,
#      idle thread parked, schedulerInBadState=true), 3 pass. This masks the cache oracles at ideal=1.
#
# HELD (no violation in the sweeps)
#  - XSFT with deliberately too-small assumed masks (2,580 xsftSmall props in H2) and pinned/aliased tweakable ids: no wrong value that
#    the toggles attribute to masks or aliasing (W5/W6 hold under fuzzing).
#  - Over-invalidation: 0 nodes invalidated without a touched read across 23,860 checkpoints (inv.expected=733,524, inv.under=43,587
#    where a touched read did not change the resolved value or was shadowed).
#  - TTrack reachability: 0 violations over 5.9 M node checks / 12.5 M (node, tweakable) edges, at watermark 1 and default.
#  - H5 scheduler accounting at the end of every completed run: ok.
#  - Memoised oracle == ProbeDag.SequentialEvaluator (selftest).
#
# NOT FINDINGS (harness corrections made during the campaign)
#  - TTrack NOROOT/UNREACHABLE for BYNAME RHS reads: the tracker roots BIND/BIND_ONCE RHS reads in the child but not BYNAME ones, and
#    still invalidates (ttprobe); reads through BYNAME RHS and when clauses are excluded from the reachability check.
#  - STALE/VERSION_LAG after an update that threw (N5): the model now marks that tracker subtree unverifiable (eval.skippedPoisoned).
#  - HANG:unresponsive (5 runs): 458-prop DAGs with 50 us delays outran the parent's process timeout while making progress; 0-1/5 on rerun.
#
# COVERAGE (sweeps)
#  H2: 480 runs, 52,080 props (max 458/run), 2,916 scenario nodes (depth1 972, depth2 684, depth3 468, depth4 312; unordered 444,
#      nested 156, twice 276, equal-sibling 132, mode-twin 72, tagged 108), tweaks 7,092 (instance 3,348, property 3,036, when 708,
#      by-name 1,656 / bind 384 / bindOnce 444), policies basic 12,372 default(XSFT) 25,020 xsftReal 4,428 xsftSmall 2,580 xs 2,820
#      dontCache 4,860; 4,708,600 requests (469,298 under a child cancel scope, 15,256 actually cancelled, 520,105 ISD).
#  H3: 1,200 runs, 141,264 props, trackers root 802 / consistent 1,584 / concurrent 736 (counted in runs that completed), 23,860 phases,
#      tweaks 156,304 (instance 71,738, property 63,803, when 20,763, by-name 42,150 / bind 9,552 / bindOnce 10,360), updates: addSync
#      30,970 addAsync 24,667 batchSync 9,081 batchAsync 8,704 (multi-tracker 3,933) setPluginTag 7,042 newChildScenario 729 dispose 1,531;
#      evaluations checked 1,220,348 (client sync/async/lowPri 146,585/145,552/142,915, driver 50,759, cancellable 20,206 of which 8,043
#      cancelled mid-flight), 41,702 cancelled results skipped, 21 ambiguous (>48 version combinations).
#
# Per-configuration pass/fail, families, reruns and minimisation lines follow (raw), then the post-sweep checks.
